heading_en: Buckets, Risk Weights and Correlations for Delta Risk of Commodity Risk
summary_ja: コモディティ・リスクのデルタ・リスクについて、バケット分類、リスク・ウェイト、リスク・ファクター間及びバケット間の相関係数並びに合算時の取扱いを定める。
summary_en: Sets the bucket classification, risk weights, correlation coefficients (between risk factors and between buckets) and aggregation treatment for delta risk of commodity risk.
paragraphs: For delta risk of commodity risk, risk factors shall be classified into eleven buckets according to the categories of commodity bucket listed in the middle column of the following table and examples of commodities assigned to each commodity bucket listed in the lower column. {{T:p379t0}}

The risk weights used for delta risk of commodity risk shall be as prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the category of bucket number listed in the upper column of the same table (meaning the bucket number classified under the preceding paragraph; the same applies below in this Article). {{T:p380t1}}

The correlation coefficient (ρ_{kl}) between risk factors used for delta risk of commodity risk shall, where the bucket falls under any of bucket numbers 1 through 11, be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p380i0}}

In the formula of the preceding paragraph, {{F:p380i1}}, {{F:p380i2}} and {{F:p380i3}} shall be as prescribed in each of the following items according to the following categories of correlation coefficient. (i) {{F:p380i4}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the commodity of sensitivity k and the commodity of sensitivity l are the same: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): the value prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the bucket number in the same table. {{T:p380t2}}. (ii) {{F:p381i0}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the tenor of sensitivity k and the tenor of sensitivity l are the same: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 99.0%. (iii) {{F:p381i1}}: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where the delivery locations of the commodities of the two sensitivities are the same: 100%. (b) In cases other than (a): 99.9%.

In aggregating risk-weighted sensitivities within the same bucket for delta risk of commodity risk, in aggregating the following commodities, each sensitivity to be aggregated shall be recognized as a separate commodity. (i) Aggregation between commodities of the same commodity type and different delivery locations. (ii) Where bucket number 3 applies, aggregation of the commodities listed in (a) or (b) below. (a) Aggregation between commodities with different electricity delivery time zones or different electricity contract time zones concluded in financial markets. (b) Aggregation between commodities relating to electricity generated in separate regions. (iii) Where bucket number 4 applies, aggregation of the commodities listed in (a) or (b) below. (a) Aggregation between commodities with different transport types or operating routes. (b) Aggregation between commodities with different cargo delivery weeks.

The correlation coefficient (γ_{bc}) between buckets used for delta risk of commodity risk shall be as prescribed in each of the following items according to the following cases. (i) Where both buckets to be aggregated fall under any of bucket numbers 1 through 10: 20%. (ii) Where one of the buckets to be aggregated falls under bucket number 11: 0%.
